apple-icloud-mcp 0.2.0

- Added note that `apple-swift-mcp` on Mac can now manage Music.app playlists locally, including renaming, deleting, and reordering tracks without tokens.
- Updated documentation for improved clarity on playlist management, highlighting when web tokens are required and when Mac-native features apply.
- Removed the redundant `skill-card.md` file.

apple-icloud-mcp 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Provides unified access to Apple Music, iCloud Calendar, Contacts, Mail, Apple Maps (directions/places), WeatherKit, Podcasts, and iTunes/App Store search via web services.
- Works from any OS; no Mac required.
- Features tools for playlist management, calendar events, contacts, mail, maps, and weather.
- Includes detailed guidance for setup, credentials, and safe usage of each tool.
- Unofficial implementation; not affiliated with Apple.
